prototype: P1 fem_prototype.py (host Python, NOT shipped code)
part: cantilever beam 100x10x10 mm, steel E=200000 MPa nu=0.3

statics.note_vm: FEM value is per-element CENTROID von Mises on a 2.5 mm voxel mesh; the analytic 60 MPa is the outer-fibre peak. Centroid of the outermost root element's centroid sits 3.75 mm from the neutral axis vs 5 mm at the fibre (0.75x), so a lower FEM centroid number (~45 MPa bending-only estimate) is expected on this coarse mesh - reported as-is, not scaled.

modal.note: Lumped mass, same mesh/BCs as statics. First two FEM roots are the degenerate bending pair (y and z planes) - expected for a square cross-section.

thermal.note: Uniform cross-section + end Dirichlet faces => exact solution is linear in x; FEM must reproduce it to solver precision.
